title: Move-Out Accounting Note: End of Billing Responsibility, Final Bill and Utility Account Closure
content:
# End of Billing Responsibility and the Final Bill — Utility Services Program

**1. Service end date.** Billing responsibility on a Utility Services Program account ends on the service end date, which is the lease's move-out date or the transfer move date. On that date the account moves to final billing.

**2. Final reads and the final bill.** Final reads are taken on the service end date, and the final bill is issued within the program's final bill period, counted in calendar days after the service end date.

**3. Nothing after the service end date.** No line may be billed for any day after the service end date; the utility of a vacant apartment home is the community's cost.

**4. Closure.** An account is closed only once its final bill has been issued and its balance is zero or has been carried into the final account statement. An account that never activated is closed with no bill when its lease application is withdrawn.

**Retired description.** The description of the final bill as the last period's usage, allocation or overage lines and flat or package lines prorated through the service end date is **no longer in force**. The timing in Clause 2 and Clauses 1, 3 and 4 remain in force.

## Closure conditions

| Final bill issued? | Balance | Account may be closed? |
|---|---|---|
| yes | zero | yes |
| yes | carried into the final account statement | yes |
| yes | open and not carried | no |
| no | any | no |

*Example (hypothetical move-out):* a resident moves out on August 20. August 20 is the service end date and the date of the final reads; no line may bill August 21 or later. On a program with a 45-day final bill period the final bill is issued no later than the 45th calendar day after August 20.

superseded_clauses: the last period's usage, allocation or overage lines and flat or package lines prorated through the service end date
